title: Darwin Core + Frictionless Data Package parse-in / pack-out adapter (canonical model)
context: Standards-conformant I/O is how the toolkit drops into the existing ecosystem (GBIF, Frictionless) rather than building a parallel universe. This adapter parses Darwin Core / DwC-Archive and Frictionless Data Package into the canonical record model and packs outputs back out, carrying license and provenance through. Per the agent-neutral-core rule, all platform/format specifics live in @csp/adapter-*. Depends on csp-engine-002.
objective: Implement the Darwin Core (incl. DwC-Archive) and Frictionless Data Package parse-in / pack-out adapter against the canonical record model, with CI-validated output conformance and preserved license + provenance.
acceptanceCriteria: Parses Darwin Core (and DwC-Archive) and Frictionless Data Package into the canonical record model
Packs outputs back as conformant DwC-Archive / Frictionless Data Package
Output conformance validated in CI; license + provenance carried through to the packaged output
All platform/format specifics kept in @csp/adapter-* (core stays agent-neutral)
output: A PR adding the @csp/adapter-* package for Darwin Core + Frictionless Data Package parse-in / pack-out with CI conformance checks.
